Name: All Season
Tasting_Notes: cloves, dark chocolate, and toasted nuts — perfectly balancing warmth and boldness in every sip
Desc: A recommended coffee choice for your Americano, Cappuccino and Latte. A comforting classic, our All Seasons blend delivers rich notes of cloves, dark chocolate, and toasted nuts — perfectly balancing warmth and boldness in every sip. Crafted with medium roast, washed Arabica beans, it’s a go-to choice for any time of the year. Elevate your everyday coffee ritual with this versatile and flavour-packed brew.

Name: Aloha
Tasting_Notes: Pineapple fermented arabica coffee from the region of Chikmagalur, a unique coffee that has crisp and bright acidity with long lasting sweetness.
Desc: Pineapple fermented arabica coffee from the region of Chikmagalur, a unique coffee that has crisp and bright acidity with long lasting sweetness. A unique coffee to make pour overs and Aeropress.

Name: Blossom
Desc: From the lush folds of the Western Ghats, this coffee is nurtured under a canopy of shade trees at Hegbal Estate, tended with care by producer Mr. Menezes. A meticulous anaerobic natural process elevates the cup to reveal a delicate yet layered character.

Name: Cold Brew Summers
Tasting_Notes: The coffee start tasting with high citrus notes, a mellow sweet break while you gulp down the sip and lasts with dried fruits and chocolates notes.
Desc: A unique blend of two differently processed specialty arabica from Chikmagalur region, that gives a great mouthfeel to your coffee with sweet long lasting finish. The coffee start tasting with high citrus notes, a mellow sweet break while you gulp down the sip and lasts with dried fruits and chocolates notes.

Name: Espresso Bench
Desc: Our beautiful blending of specialty arabica and robusta beans, a unique combination to enhance the sweetness of the coffee, bright acidity and balanced bitterness with bold mouthfeel.

Name: FCCR EARTH CUP 200 ml
Desc: Beautifully handcrafted ceramic cups for your everyday coffee.   Its balanced size makes it perfect for both daily use and special occasions, adding a touch of timeless charm to your table.

Name: Jodhpur Blend
Tasting_Notes: The blend that gives an extra ordinary beauty to your espressos with heavy body, little complexity of chocolate and caramel, with aromatics of clove and dry spice.
Desc: Favourite from the baristas, a blend of naturals and washed specialty arabica that gives an extra premiumness to your milk based coffee beverages. The blend that gives an extra ordinary beauty to your espressos with heavy body, little complexity of chocolate and caramel, with aromatics of clove and dry spice.

Name: Jodhpur Jewel
Tasting_Notes: A rare fermentation that heightens brightness and clarity, revealing earthy whispers of cinnamon and clove.
Desc: A rare fermentation that heightens brightness and clarity, revealing earthy whispers of cinnamon and clove. With a candy-like sweetness and nutty mouthfeel, this cup is as unique as it is inviting.

Name: Nectar
Tasting_Notes: cherry, blood orange, and golden honey
Desc: Dive into a cup of pure indulgence with Nectar — a honey-sundried Arabica bursting with vibrant notes of cherry, blood orange, and golden honey. Naturally sweet and elegantly bright, this luxurious blend promises a refreshing coffee experience. Perfect for those who crave a fruity, smooth profile in every delicious sip.

Name: Nectar 2.0
Tasting_Notes: Dripping with honeyed sweetness, crisp apple brightness, and lush stone fruit depth, this cup is pure indulgence.
Desc: Dripping with honeyed sweetness, crisp apple brightness, and lush stone fruit depth, this cup is pure indulgence. Silky-smooth with a 10/10 body, it’s a coffee that lingers long after the last sip.

Name: Pulp sundried
Tasting_Notes: Ratnagiri means Pearl Mountains because of dense silver oak trees that gives a silvery hue to the hills and because of unique postioning the producers grows some of the best specialty coffee with fruit, floral and aromatic experience.
Desc: Ratnagiri means Pearl Mountains because of dense silver oak trees that gives a silvery hue to the hills and because of unique postioning the producers grows some of the best specialty coffee with fruit, floral and aromatic experience.

Name: Ratnagiri Gems
Desc: Microlot masterpiece showcasing finest quality of Indian Specialty from Ratnagiri estate with a beautiful balance of acidity, body and flavours.

Name: Ratnagiri YB Naturals
Tasting_Notes: The specialty coffee is processed with yeast and bacteria in anaerobic fermentation to develop unique flavours and highlight the fruity floral characteristics of the coffee.
Desc: The specialty coffee is processed with yeast and bacteria in anaerobic fermentation to develop unique flavours and highlight the fruity floral characteristics of the coffee. Recommended brewing methods are v60, aeropress and kalita.

Name: Red Velvet
Desc: Slow-crafted under the Western Ghats sun, this Arabica carries a natural sweetness and heady aromatics. Bold yet elegant, it’s a true sunshine coffee—perfect for a bright pour-over or a lively Aeropress brew.

Name: Rum Barrel Aged Microlot
Desc: This coffee masterfully blends the character of specialty microlot coffee with the intense, bold undertones of rum. The brewed cup is a reflection of chivalrous desire - delivering a sensational burst of layered flavours that captivates the palate. Recommended brewing methods are pour-over for overall aromatic experience and cold brews for slow sipping and bold mouthfeel.

Name: Whiskey Barrel Aged
Desc: Bold and sweet coffee, a unique trend where you try to bring the two most loved beverage flavours merged into one, specialty arabica fermented in whiskey barrels to have smooth sweet and funky cup of coffee
